lines.text: You type a long, messy description of what you need. The login page flickers on Safari.
Then the app asks for a title. A required field, after you already explained everything once.
So nobody names anything. By Friday your board is fifty cards called new task.
So Agent R Q writes the title for you. The moment you create a task, it reads your description.
A small language model runs right inside your browser tab. No server call, and no network wait.
Your description never leaves your device. Customer names, secret paths, half finished ideas, all stay with you.
A second later the task has a clear name: fix Safari login flicker on token refresh.
Your board stays readable. Every card says what it is, so you can scan it at a glance.
Your agents read those titles too, so the task they pick up already tells them the job.
And when you need an old task, search by its title. Type login, and there it is.
The title is only a suggestion. If you want different words, edit it. Otherwise it simply works.
Tell me below, what is the worst task name your agents ever left behind? Try it at Agent R Q dot com.
